A LITTLE CLARITY

Good questions.
Straight answers.

The essentials, before you begin.

What can I search?

Start with your email, a public username, a Discord ID, a domain or an IPv4 address. The workspace also includes public social profiles, IntelX metadata and public-landmark photo lookups. Use exposure checks only for accounts you own or are authorized to assess.

Do I need an account to search?

This private testing build has the supplied license loaded, so you can submit a search from the workspace. It does not send a search automatically. Website accounts are separate and are not active yet. Keep this testing file private; its credential remains readable in the source.

Which cryptocurrencies can I use?

BTC on Bitcoin, ETH on Ethereum, LTC on Litecoin, SOL on Solana, BNB on BNB Smart Chain, and USDT on Ethereum (ERC-20). USDT on Tron, Solana or BNB Smart Chain is not supported by this checkout. Always match the network and confirm a merchant invoice before sending.

Does sending crypto activate my plan?

Not automatically in this standalone file. The owner's receiving addresses are configured, but invoice creation, transaction verification and plan activation still need a payment service. Do not send funds until the merchant confirms fulfillment and gives you an invoice. Copying an address is not payment confirmation.

Are the plans lifetime?

Basic is $35 lifetime and Pro is $65 lifetime. Enterprise is listed at $85 as a one-time payment; its access duration must be confirmed by the owner. These are the owner's proposed plans. Provider quotas still apply regardless of advertised allowances.

What do 75 sources, 950B+ records and 7TB mean?

Those are owner-supplied platform figures, not verified measurements. This client connects 12 documented lookup modules and does not include a local database. Machine View is not available through the supplied Kryptonite API.

Are my searches saved?

Results stay in memory and there is no local search history or analytics. This private test build contains a license in the source; remove it before sharing or hosting. Kryptonite receives your query and may retain it under its own policies. Exported files remain on your device; displayed and exported sensitive fields are masked.

Why might a lookup fail?

A missing license, a provider quota or a browser CORS restriction can block a request. The workspace shows the reported error. Opening the HTML as a local file can also restrict browser requests; HTTPS hosting and provider origin permission may be needed.

New to unmasked?

Account service is not connected in this standalone file. Forms validate locally; no password is saved or sent. Website accounts require an authenticated server; your Kryptonite license is separate.

Connect your API

Enter your Kryptonite license to start a private search session.

This private test file contains your license. Disconnect clears the active session, but reloading loads the bundled license again. Remove the credential from the source before sharing or hosting.

Connection details

Requests go directly to https://www.kryptonite.wtf/api/v1. Browser access requires the provider to allow this page’s origin through CORS. A shared license must stay on your own server.

Technical reference

This client follows the Kryptonite API documentation supplied with the project. Endpoint availability and response shapes have not been verified with a live license.

Authentication

X-API-Key: YOUR_API_KEY
Accept: application/json

The key is sent only in headers, to the fixed Kryptonite origin. No browser storage, third-party scripts, analytics, or external fonts are used.

Included modules

ModuleEndpointInput

Usage and limits

GET /api/v1/me checks your plan without consuming a daily request. The supplied docs list 1,000 requests/day for monthly keys and 5,000/day for lifetime keys, reset at 00:00 UTC. IntelX may have an additional monthly cap. This client shows the quota reported by the server.

curl 'https://www.kryptonite.wtf/api/v1/ip?address=8.8.8.8' \
  -H 'X-API-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'

Browser compatibility

Direct requests require an OPTIONS preflight that allows this origin, GET/POST and the X-API-Key header. Opening the file with a file:// URL may be blocked by the provider. Serving the file over HTTPS gives it a normal origin, but does not guarantee CORS permission.

For a website using one shared license, keep that license on your server and authenticate visitors there. A single static HTML file cannot keep a shared API secret. A relay must also enforce its own access controls and rate limits.

Payment configuration

The three plan cards are a pre-launch catalog. To activate checkout, configure STORE.checkoutUrls with verified HTTPS payment links for each plan, then enable STORE.paymentsEnabled once the plan can be fulfilled. Optional receiving wallets are public values. They do not confirm payments or grant access.

Crypto estimates use the unauthenticated Coinbase spot price endpoint. No Kryptonite key is included in these requests. Payment confirmation, customer login, plan enforcement, and API resale require a backend or a hosted payment service. The provider’s own license remains the access control for this standalone client.

Result handling

Only recognized public profile, infrastructure, and exposure metadata fields are displayed. Credentials, contact details, precise addresses, and unrecognized fields are masked. JSON and exports use the same filtered copy. Profile claims come from the provider and should be independently checked; no-result responses do not prove the absence of exposure.

Scope

Password/combo searches, private phone/email-to-account linking, credential archives, name/phone directories, FiveM identifier searches, link unlockers, and Machine View are not included. Landmark results are estimates from the provider.

Errors

400Invalid input or unsupported module.
401Missing or invalid license.
403Inactive license or unavailable module.
429Daily quota, module cap or burst limit.
502 / 503Provider error, timeout or temporary unavailability.

Session privacy

Search results are held in memory. This private test build also contains a bundled license in its source, readable by anyone who receives the file. Disconnecting clears the active session; reloading restores the bundled license. Remove it before sharing or hosting. Downloads remain on your device.

Requests send your query or chosen photo to Kryptonite, which may retain requests under its own policies. Masking happens in this client after a response is received, so the original response can still be seen in your browser's network tools.

Use exposure checks for accounts you own or are authorized to assess. A photo lookup sends the original file, including any metadata it contains. This is an independent client and is not affiliated with Kryptonite or Intelbyte.
